attributes.board_name: Vermont Board of Allied Mental Health (Office of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board/OPR-approved continuing education (courses can be submitted to OPR for pre-approval; list of approved courses in the OPR online system). Synchronous live virtual courses count as live in-person training.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE starts with the first renewal after two years of licensure.
rules.alternatives: CE completed for one Vermont-licensed mental health profession counts toward the others held.

topics.who: All licensed mental health professionals: at least one hour on systematic oppression and anti-oppressive practice or related areas (Act 117 of 2022); online courses accepted

rules.legal_basis: 26 V.S.A. §3269; Board of Allied Mental Health Administrative Rules 3.26 ff.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal (26 V.S.A. §3269); the anti-oppression hour applies from the January 2025 renewal. Details of the CE rules (Rule 3.26 ff.) are in the Board's administrative rules PDF, which could not be read.
rules.rule_quote: 40 hours of continuing education is required beginning with your first renewal after two years of licensure and ever renewal thereafter.
